explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/281 with the positive answer (Somani; formal proof linked). If, for every choice of residues, the integers avoiding all classes a_i mod n_i have density 0, then for every ε > 0 there is a uniform k such that avoiding the first k classes always leaves density < ε. The prefix sets are periodic, so their densities exist and the encoding via HasIntDensity is sound.
